run_simulation: run a multi-item haggling simulation with buyers and sellers negotiating prices for fruit items
parse_item_and_price: parse an action string like 'apple for 3 coins' into an item name and price tuple
MultiItemHagglingPayoff_action_to_scores: map joint buyer and seller actions to numerical scores for each player in a bargaining game
MultiItemHagglingPayoff_scores_to_observ: convert numerical scores into descriptive text observations for each player after a bargaining round
configure_scenes: configure negotiation and decision scenes for a multi-item haggling simulation with buyer seller pairs
